annotation.title_clean: 道路運送車両の保安基準
annotation.title_en: Safety Standards for Road Transport Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport (now Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japan's binding ministerial ordinance setting technical safety standards for motor vehicles, mopeds and light vehicles (current version as amended to October 2026). It covers dimensions, braking, crash protection, electrical systems, cybersecurity and software-update capability, driver-assistance sensing and control devices, and automated operation devices, with technical details delegated to ministerial notices.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vehicles must meet structural and equipment safety standards set out in detail by ministerial notice
Electrical systems must meet cybersecurity performance standards and allow reliable software updates
Cars must have pedal-misapplication acceleration suppression devices and meet occupant and pedestrian crash-protection requirements
Devices that sense the vehicle's surroundings and control the vehicle are subject to standards, including limits on how far they may protrude
Regional Transport Bureau chiefs may relax the standards for special vehicles, subject to conditions
